Description

With the Williams 2026 Collection, Topps celebrates the tradition, innovation and legendary achievements of one of the most iconic British teams in Formula 1. Following a set dedicated to the McLaren team released in spring, this is the second Topps collection to focus exclusively on an F1 team.

Created in partnership with the Atlassian Williams F1 Team, the collection features the two current drivers Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz alongside numerous team legends, including Nigel Mansell, Alain Prost, Rubens Barrichello, David Coulthard, Juan Pablo Montoya, Damon Hill and Jacques Villeneuve.

In addition to the Autograph Card included in every box, lucky collectors may also come across one of the impressive Relic Cards and Autograph Relic Cards, which can be found as bonus cards in the boxes.

Base Cards

The collection’s BASE SET consists of 60 cards divided across 6 subsets: PURE WILLIAMS, BEHIND THE SCENES, SUPREME ENGINEERING, BEHIND THE WHEEL, MOMENTS IN MOTION and VINTAGE WILLIAMS.

Parallels

Topps has produced 5 Parallel variants for these cards, with the highest numbered to /50. These are followed by Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5 and the 1/1 FoilFractor Parallel, which exists only once for each card.

Insert Cards

With the UNION JACK Inserts, the collection’s only Insert category, Topps celebrates British Williams drivers Nigel Mansell, Damon Hill and David Coulthard on striking designs inspired by the Union Jack.

Autograph Cards

The collection’s BASE AUTOGRAPHS add driver signatures to numerous Base Card designs. Alongside the team’s two current stars, long-time Williams fans can look forward to many of the drivers who have helped shape the team’s eventful history.

The DUAL AUTOGRAPHS bring iconic Williams drivers together, including Nigel Mansell & Alain Prost, Damon Hill & Jacques Villeneuve, David Coulthard & Juan Pablo Montoya and Alex Albon & Carlos Sainz.

Relic Cards

For the Relic Cards, Topps uses not only various pieces of clothing worn by the drivers, which can be found in the collection as RACE SUIT RELICS and GLOVES RELICS, but also numerous parts from Williams race cars. This marks the first time that SEAT BELT RELICS and SKID PLANK RELICS have been used in a Sportscards collection.

Autograph Relic Cards

Special collectibles for Williams fans are the CAR BODYWORK AUTOGRAPH RELICS, which combine the signatures of the two current Williams drivers Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz with authentic bodywork from the team’s 2026 car, the FW48.

Availability

Each box in the collection contains 25 cards, divided across 5 packs with 5 cards each. According to Topps, these should always include 1 Autograph Card and 2 numbered Parallels.

The release date announced by Topps for 2026 TOPPS Williams Racing Cards is Thursday, the 1st of October 2026.

From that date, the boxes will be available in the Topps online shop. After production and delivery, which takes approximately 6 to 8 weeks, they will also be available from retailers specializing in Sportscards.
